columns.name: RESULT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: This is the Result Text Id identifying the Analyzed Survey Response entry in this table.

columns.name: SUBSCRIBER_ID
columns.description: This is the Subscriber ID associated with the Survey. Used to differentiate between different survey projects.

columns.name: SURVEY_ID
columns.description: This is the Survey Id identifying the Survey entry in this table.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_ID
columns.description: This is the Questionnaire ID associated with the Survey.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_VERSION
columns.description: This is the Questionnaire Version associated with the Questionnaire ID of this Survey.

columns.name: QUESTION_ID
columns.description: This is the Question ID associated with the Questionnaire.

columns.name: QUESTION_VERSION
columns.description: This is the Question Version associated with the Question ID in the Questionnaire.

columns.name: SURVEY_DATE
columns.description: This is the date when the Survey was created or conducted.

columns.name: OWNER_PRFL_ID
columns.description: This is the Fusion Id of the participant who wrote this survey response.

columns.name: REFERENCED_PRFL_ID
columns.description: This is the Fusion Id of the person being referred to in this survey response.

columns.name: TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the Id of the Topic being identified in this survey response.

columns.name: TOPIC_NAME
columns.description: This is the Name aka Text of the Topic being identified in this survey response.

columns.name: SENTIMENT_ID
columns.description: This is the Id of Sentiment being identified in this survey response.

columns.name: RESPONSE_TEXT
columns.description: This is the response text that the participant wrote which has been analyzed.

columns.name: EMOTION
columns.description: This is the Emotion Associated with the survey response Id.
